title: TRICARE Select Enrollment Fees in the Family Catastrophic Total of a Stay Reprocessed for Other Health Insurance
content:
**Provision.** Where the **TRICARE Select** tier's enrollment fees count toward the catastrophic cap and the payments posted on the fee account cover the installments whose coverage period has begun, those installments are added to the family catastrophic total of a reprocessed stay in full; where fees count and some but less has been paid, the payments posted are added; otherwise no enrollment fee is added.

Fees count on TRICARE Select Retiree Group A and TRICARE Select Retiree Group B; the four TRICARE Select Active Duty Family Member tiers are fee-exempt and their fees do not count. An installment's coverage period has begun when it starts on or before the adjudication date; the fee account is read back over 600 months.

## Questions the rule answers

**The beneficiary has paid every begun installment, and more.** The begun installments are added in full; a payment for an installment not yet begun adds nothing.

**The beneficiary has paid part of the begun installments.** The payments posted are added.

**Nothing has been paid, or the tier is fee-exempt.** No enrollment fee is added.

## Hypothetical accounts (TRICARE Select Retiree Group A, monthly family installments of 33.00)

| Begun installments | Payments posted | Added |
|---|---|---|
| 7, totalling 231.00 | 231.00 | 231.00 |
| 7, totalling 231.00 | 264.00 | 231.00 |
| 7, totalling 231.00 | 165.00 | 165.00 |
| 7, totalling 231.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 |
